title: Syrian Chicken Curry
description: A rich and flavorful curry dish inspired by Syrian cuisine, featuring juicy chicken and a blend of exotic spices.
instructions: 1. Heat the coconut oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
2. Add the onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
3. Add the garlic and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes.
4. Add the chicken breast and cook until browned on all sides, about 5-7 minutes.
5. In a small bowl, mix together the curry powder, cumin, and sumac.
6. Add the spice mixture to the skillet and stir to combine.
7. Pour in the chicken broth and bring to a simmer.
8. Reduce heat to low and let cook for 10-15 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through.
9. Stir in the Greek yogurt and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes.
10. Garnish with chopped cilantro and serve hot.
